title: iPhone Air Durability test -- I AM SHOCKED
summary: JerryRigEverything puts the iPhone Air through scratch, bend and durability tests and is surprised that the ultra-thin phone proves very tough. The video is sponsored by dbrand cases.
why: Cited as evidence against the assumption that thin modern phones are fragile.

quote.text: take a look at the latest Jerry Rig Everything video where it exceeded his typical scratch test resits and he was unable to bend it with his hands.
